spans.s:
n. (-श्रं)
1 A tear.
2 Blood.
E.
अश्रू to spread, &c. and र affix: see अश्रु and अस्र.

m. (-स्रः)
1 A corner, an angle.
2 Hair.
n. (-स्रं)
1

Blood.
3

A tear.
E.
अस to cast or throw, &c. affix रक्.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Unbelieving.
f. (-द्धा)
Unbelief.
E.
अ neg. श्रद्धा faith.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Not performing exequial rites, not entitled to them, not belonging or relating to them.
m. (-द्धः)
Nonperformance of exequial rites.
E.
अ neg. श्राद्ध funereal ceremony.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unbelieving, incredulous, having no faith.
E.
अ neg. श्रद्धधान believing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Incredible, not to be believed.
E.
अ and श्रद्धेय worthy of faith.

m. (-पः)
A fiend, a cannibal.
E.
अश्र blood, and प who drinks.

mf. (-पः-पा)
A Rākṣasa or goblin.
f. (-पा)
A leech.
E.
अस्र blood, and प who drinks.

m. (-पः)
The nineteenth lunar mansion.
E.
आस्रप a Rākṣasa or goblin, and अण् aff. one of this race being the deity of the asterism.

n. (-णं)
Deafness, loss of hearing.
E.
अ neg. श्रवण hearing.

m. (-मः)
1 Freshness, freedom from fatigue.
2 Laziness, want of exertion.
E.
अ neg. श्रम fatigue.

m. (-मः)
1 A religious order, of which there are four kinds referable to the different periods of life, 1st, that of the student or Brahmacārī; 2d, that of the householder or Gṛhastha; 3d, that of the anchorite or Vānaprastha; and 4th, that of the beggar or Bhikṣu: see ब्रह्मचारी, &c.
2 A college, a school.
3 A hermitage, the abode of retired saints or sages.
4 A wood or thicket.
E.
आङ् before श्रम to perform religious austerities, affix घञ्.

adv. n. (-न्तं) adj. mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Eternal, continual.
2 Unwearied.
E.
अ neg. and श्रान्त wearied, part. past. of श्रम.

f. (-श्रिः)
1 The edge of a sword.
2 A corner, the angle of a room or house.
E.
श्रिञ to serve, आङ् prefixed, आ becomes अ; also अश्री and आश्रि.

f. (-स्रिः)
Ten millions.

f. (-श्रिः)
The edge of a sword: see अश्रि.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unlucky, unpropitious.
E.
अ neg. श्री fortune, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Inglorious, unfortunate.
E.
अ neg. श्रीमत् fortunate.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Unlucky, unprosperous.
E.
अ neg. श्री prosperity, ला to have, affix क.

n. (-श्रु)
A tear.
E.
अ neg. श्रि to serve, डुन् Uṇādi affix; it is also written अश्र.

n. (-स्रु)
A tear.
E.
अस to cast or reject, and रु aff.

Unheard.
2

Not directed by or contrary to the Vedas.
E.
अ and श्रुत heard, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Promised, agreed.
2 Heard.
E.
आङ् before श्रु to hear, क्त aff.

f. (-ली)
Fistula lacrymalis.
E.
अश्रु and नाली a channel.

m. (-तः)
A flow of tears.
E.
अश्रु, and पात fall.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Worthless, useless, unprofitable, bad.
2 Inferior, worse.
E.
अ neg. श्रेयस् excellent.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठ)
1 Inferior, worse.
2 Bad, vile.
E.
अ neg. श्रेष्ठ best.

m. (-यः)
A Brahman who has not read the Vedas.
E.
अ neg. श्रोत्रिय a learned Brahman.

m. (-ण्ठः)
An arrow.
E.
अस्र and कण्ठ throat.

n. (-जं)
Flesh.
E.
अस्र blood, and ज produced.

m. (-जित्)
A plant, commonly Kabātabentu.

n. (-त्तं)
Plethora, haemorrhage^1, epistaxis, involuntary discharge of blood from the mouth, nostrils, anus, &c.
E.
अस्र and पित्त bile: both humors being supposed to be affected.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-का)
Chyle, chyme.
E.
अस्र blood, मातृ the parent, कन् affix of similitude.

f.
A plant, (Mimosa pudica.)

m. (-कः)
The white Tulasi.

n. (-वं)
A granulation, (of flesh.)
E.
अ neg. स्रु to distil, अप् aff.

m. (-रुः)
The head of a religious order, a preceptor, a principal.
E.
आश्रम a convent, and गुरु senior.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The special duty or duties of each order of life.
E.
आश्रम and धर्म्म duty.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to one of the four orders, see आश्रम.
E.
आश्रम as above, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि)
1 Belonging to one of the four orders.
3 Belonging to a hermitage, a hermit, an anchorite, &c.
E.
आश्रम and इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
Being inclined or addicted to, following, practising.
2 A recipient, the person or thing in which any quality or article is inherent, retained or received.
3 An asylum, a [] place of refuge.
4 A patron, a protector.
5 Having recourse to a protector or asylum.
6 A dwelling.
7 Contiguity, vicinity.
8 Source, origin.
9 A plea, an excuse.
10 Appropriate act, one consistent with the character of the agent.
E.
आङ् before श्री to serve, अच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Refuge, asylum, means of protection or security. आङ् before श्रि to serve, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be had recourse to.
2 To be practised or followed.
E.
आङ् before श्रि to serve, affix अनीयर्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Protecting, supporting, one who is the refuge of any other.
E.
आश्रय and भूत become.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
A forfeiter of an asylum, one who by misconduct, &c. loses patronage or protection.
m. (-शः)
A name of fire.
E.
आश्रय a house, &c. अश to eat, or consume, and अण् affix: similar compounds occur frequently, as आश्रयध्वंसिन्, आश्रयभुज्, &c.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Compliant, obedient.
m. (-वः)
1 A promise, an engagement.
2 Distress, fatigue.
3 Fault, transgression.
E.
आङ्, श्रु to hear, अच् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Distress, pain, affliction.
2 Flow, running, discharge.
E.
आङ्, स्रु to go, and अच् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Pain, affliction.
2 Flow, issue, running, discharge.
E.
आङ्। स्रु to ooze, ण aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Inhabiting, dwelling in, resorting to as a retreat or asylum.
2 Following, practising, observing.
3 Using, employing, having recourse to.
4 Receiving any thing, as an inherent or integral part.
5 Taking one's station at or on, as at a window or a seat, &c.
6 A dependant.
E.
आङ् before श्रि to serve, क्त aff.

ind.
1 Having sought or obtained an asylum.
2 Having recourse to, employing, practising.
E.
आङ् before श्रि to serve, ल्यप् affix, तुक् augment.
